rows.reasoning: Her Nay on HB 1608 is a No on a multi-subject bill, and her failed Amendment #11 (letting a student "withdraw the" request to avoid parental notice) and her statement that districts' own name and pronoun policies "have worked well" lean against a state mandate to notify parents. None of these matches every clause of "Require staff to keep a student's gender identity from parents unless the student consents" or "Forbid rules that require schools to tell parents", so only a side is shown.

quotes.text: School districts have long set their own policies regarding curricula and name and pronoun changes, and these policies have worked well for the vast majority of families: the last thing we need is more nannying and interference from inexpert legislators.
All this bill does is guarantee that more kids across Indiana, LGBTQ+ or not, will be put in danger of losing homes and support without their consent or awareness.
